events.description: A large crowd is gathered at night around a large fire (likely a vehicle or barricade) in the street; people are moving chaotically, some running, others observing or gesturing; smoke and flares are present; later frames show a line of riot police in formation facing the crowd, indicating violent unrest or confrontation.

Large-scale violent unrest with dense crowds, heavy smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades), multiple fires, and apparent confrontations between groups of people and uniformed personnel in riot gear. Debris is scattered, and the scene shows sustained chaotic activity consistent with a riot.

A large group of riot police in full gear confronts a group of individuals on an elevated roadway; smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenade) is deployed, and debris is scattered on the ground, indicating active unrest and confrontation.

Multiple officers surround and carry an individual wearing a yellow shirt who appears limp and unresponsive; the person is being moved through a dense crowd of officers and civilians without visible voluntary movement, suggesting they are injured or incapacitated and being removed under duress.

A person in a yellow shirt is being carried horizontally by multiple individuals, including police officers in riot gear (some with 'POLISI' visible), through a dense crowd. The individual appears limp and unresponsive, suggesting they are injured or incapacitated, and the manner of transport—through a chaotic, tightly packed group—indicates potential mistreatment or neglect of medical need amid unrest.

A large, densely packed crowd of civilians and uniformed personnel (including riot police with helmets and shields) is engaged in intense, chaotic movement. There is physical jostling, overlapping bodies, and apparent struggle to control or move through the space. The presence of multiple officers restraining or carrying an individual, combined with the overall disorder and use of protective gear, indicates collective violent unrest.

A person in a yellow shirt is being carried or dragged horizontally by multiple individuals, including police officers in riot gear, through a dense crowd. The individual appears limp and unresponsive, suggesting they are helpless or incapacitated, while being moved forcefully amid chaotic movement.

Sustained violent unrest: dense crowd of civilians and police in riot gear engaged in close physical confrontation; objects appear to be thrown or used as shields; scene includes smoke/dust, barricades, and a police vehicle with flashing lights at distance (frames f12–f15). The earlier frames show coordinated lifting/dragging of an individual amid pushing and shoving, consistent with collective violent disorder.

Multiple individuals are engaged in chaotic, aggressive movement across a street with debris and damaged banners; some appear to be throwing objects or confronting others, consistent with collective violent unrest.
In frames f6–f9, two individuals in the center of the crosswalk engage in close physical contact: one appears to push or strike the other, who stumbles backward—indicative of mutual physical combat.

In frames f10–f13, one individual is on the ground near the center while another stands over them and appears to strike or kick; the grounded person shows no active resistance, suggesting a helpless victim being attacked.

Nighttime street scene with heavy smoke, scattered debris, and visible fire in the background; a McDonald's sign is partially visible, and the environment suggests ongoing violent unrest or aftermath of clashes.

In frames f12–f15, indistinct figures appear engaged in close physical interaction near the left side of the frame (behind palm trees), with motion suggesting mutual combat amid smoke and low visibility.
Sustained fire and smoke in an urban setting with visible structural damage and silhouettes of people moving erratically near flames; consistent with violent unrest or arson during a riot.

Large, dense crowd pressing against a glass barrier (likely a police station window), with multiple individuals holding up phones to record; visible 'POLISI' signage confirms location; behavior indicates aggressive confrontation or siege-like activity typical of a riot.

A dense crowd presses against a glass barrier, with visible agitation, pushing, and chaotic movement; smoke or haze intensifies over time, and individuals raise phones to record while the crowd surges repeatedly—indicative of collective violent unrest or clash with authorities behind the barrier.
In frames f9–f13, distinct close-range physical struggles are visible within the crowd: arms interlocked, bodies twisting, and forceful shoving consistent with mutual combat amid the larger unrest.

A large group of people, many in riot gear, are engaged in violent unrest behind a glass barrier; individuals are seen throwing objects and clashing, with smoke and chaotic movement indicating a riot.

A bright muzzle flash is visible in frame f2 (157.0 s) near the upper center of the crowd behind the glass, consistent with a firearm discharge; this flash is absent in adjacent frames before and after, supporting a momentary shooting event.
Wide-angle view shows a street scene at night with police armored vehicle, barricades, fires, and groups of people clashing or moving aggressively; debris and smoke indicate ongoing violent unrest.
Large-scale violent unrest involving a dense crowd clashing with riot police in full gear; smoke, debris, and fire are present, with police vehicles deployed and barriers breached.
